description: Restyle the Experience, Education, Projects, Contact, Footer sections and the ProjectModal, plus update the page-level files (Login, Dashboard, Services). Also complete the global.css responsive rules update and ensure the full build is clean. This feat depends on FEAT-001 (structure) and FEAT-002 (Navbar/Hero/About/Skills done) completing first.
steps: Step 1 — Restyle src/sections/Experience.jsx: Vertical timeline with alternating cards on desktop (odd items left, even items right using grid or flexbox offset). On mobile: single column. Timeline line: a vertical line div with gradient (from --accent-primary to --accent-secondary). Timeline dot/pin: glowing circle with --accent-primary box-shadow. Each card: glass card (backdrop-blur, --bg-glass, rounded-2xl). Date badge: indigo/purple pill with gradient background. Company name row: bold with accent color. Highlight bullets: checkmark icon in --accent-cyan. Tech tags: small glass pills. Keep all existing i18n, data from experience array in portfolioData.js, and id='experience' on the section.

Step 2 — Restyle src/sections/Education.jsx: University cards use glass styling with left border in --accent-primary. AAU card: keep the red AAU brand color (#ef4444) for the logo border and left accent. Certifications grid: 3-column on desktop, 2-col on tablet, 1-col mobile. Each cert card: glass card with hover lift. Cert icon wrap: small gradient icon box. Keep all existing data from educationData, coursework tags, and id='education'.

Step 3 — Restyle src/sections/Projects.jsx: Replace the single-card showcase layout with a responsive 3-column grid of project cards. Each project card: glass card with rounded-2xl, project image on top with gradient overlay on hover (showing 'View Details' pill), tech badges row, category pill badge, and 3 action buttons (Live Demo, Source Code, Case Study). Add a filter tab bar above the grid with category options extracted from projects data: 'All', 'Full Stack', 'ERP & Systems'. Keep the existing ProjectModal logic — clicking 'Case Study' or the image overlay opens the modal. Navigation arrows and selector strip from old layout can be removed (replaced by grid). Keep id='projects'.

Step 4 — Restyle src/sections/ProjectModal.jsx: Update modal container to use glass styling (backdrop-blur, --bg-surface background, rounded-3xl). Modal header: gradient badge for category. Tab buttons: active tab uses gradient underline. Tech pills: glass mini-pills. Modal backdrop: rgba(0,0,0,0.8) with blur(12px). Keep all existing tab logic (overview/features/tech tabs), keyboard escape handler, and data bindings.

Step 5 — Restyle src/sections/Contact.jsx: Split layout: left column has contact info + social links, right column has the form. Form inputs: add focus ring (box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(99,102,241,0.3)) on focus using :focus CSS. Submit button: gradient background, loading spinner state (replace text with animated spinner). Toast notifications: the alert-box classes get updated colors to match new palette (success: emerald, error: rose). Quick subject pills: active state uses gradient background. Keep ALL existing API integration (api.post('/contact', form) call in handleSubmit), form state, validation, copy handlers, and i18n keys. id='contact' preserved.

Step 6 — Restyle src/components/Footer.jsx: Minimal 4-column layout: brand+tagline+social icons | Navigation | Work & Credentials | Location. Social icon circles: glass with hover gradient fill. Back-to-top button: glass pill with arrow icon. Footer bottom bar: copyright + built-with + back-to-top. Brand name uses gradient-text class. Footer background: --bg-surface with top border in --border-glass.

Step 7 — Update page-level files for visual consistency: src/pages/Login.jsx: the auth-card should use glass styling (update the .auth-card CSS class to use var(--bg-glass) and backdrop-blur). src/pages/Dashboard.jsx: metric cards use glass style. Dashboard panel uses glass style. Telemetry table header uses --accent-primary for header text. Activity dots use appropriate accent colors. src/pages/Services.jsx: service feature cards use glass style. Estimator card uses glass style. Services already imports Skills component from ../components/Skills — keep that import intact.

Step 8 — Update global.css responsive rules: Ensure all new glass card classes, gradient-text, AnimatedSection, and section-specific styles have proper @media (max-width: 1040px) and (max-width: 768px) breakpoints. Mobile hamburger drawer should use slideDown animation. Hero on mobile: single column, profile card below text. Projects grid: 2-col on tablet, 1-col on mobile.

Step 9 — Final cleanup: Verify src/App.css can be completely emptied or minimized (the new global.css handles all styles). Verify src/index.css only contains bare minimum CSS vars that don't conflict. Verify no duplicate class definitions between index.css, App.css, and global.css that might cause unexpected overrides. Update global.css to ensure .portfolio-app-root has min-height: 100svh and flexbox column layout (needed by pages that render Navbar + main + Footer).
Step 10 — Write verdict and completion marker: Set FEAT-003 status to 'completed' in the FEAT-003.json file. Run npm run build and confirm exit code 0. Record any findings in the findings field.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build exits 0 with zero errors
Experience section has alternating timeline cards on desktop
Projects section shows a 3-column glass card grid with filter tabs
Contact form API integration still works (api.post('/contact')) — do not break this
Contact form submit button shows loading state
Footer uses minimal glass design with gradient brand text
Login page glass card renders properly in both dark and light themes
Dashboard page metrics cards have glass styling
All sections have proper mobile responsive layouts (single column on <768px)
ProjectModal opens when clicking a project card's Case Study button
All 3 language translations still work after section file moves
The portfolio-app-root class provides correct full-height flex column layout for page-level files
findings: All 10 steps implemented successfully. Build passes cleanly (zero errors, zero warnings) at 840ms. Key decisions: (1) Experience: replaced linear timeline with a CSS grid alternating layout (.timeline-alt-item with grid-template-columns: 1fr 48px 1fr) — odd items render card in col 1, even items render card in col 3, with glowing dot pin in col 2. A vertical gradient line (--accent-primary to --accent-secondary) is layered behind dots using absolute positioning. Date badges upgraded to gradient pill (.period-badge-gradient). Tech tags are glass pills (.exp-tech-badge-glass). Bullet check icons use --accent-cyan. (2) Education: university main cards and cert cards upgraded to glass (.edu-glass-card, .cert-glass-card with backdrop-blur). AAU red brand color (#ef4444) preserved exactly on both border-left and logo circle. Cert icon wrap uses gradient background (.cert-icon-wrap-gradient). Certifications grid is 3-col desktop, 2-col tablet, 1-col mobile. (3) Projects: completely replaced single-card showcase with a 3-column responsive glass card grid (.projects-grid-new). Filter tab bar (.projects-filter-bar) extracts categories from portfolioData at runtime. Each card has image with gradient hover overlay showing 'View Details' pill, category chip, tech pills row, and 3 action buttons (Live Demo, Source, Case Study). Old navigation arrows and selector strip removed. ProjectModal still opens on Case Study click. (4) ProjectModal: modal backdrop upgraded to rgba(0,0,0,0.8) + blur(12px). Container, header and footer use glass + backdrop-blur(20px) + rounded-3xl. Tech badges use glass mini-pill style. Active tab gets gradient background. (5) Contact: API integration (api.post('/contact', form)) preserved exactly. Submit button upgraded with .contact-spinner (CSS spin animation for loading state). Quick subject pill active state uses gradient background. Alert colors match existing emerald/rose palette. (6) Footer: brand name uses .gradient-text. Social icons replaced with glass circles (.footer-social-circle) with gradient hover fill. Back-to-top is a glass pill (.back-to-top-pill). Footer has border-top: 1px solid --border-glass. (7) Dashboard: metric cards and panels get .glass-card class. Telemetry table header uses .text-primary (accent color). Services: feature cards and estimator card get .glass-card. Login: .auth-card already had glass styling from existing CSS (bg-glass, backdrop-blur defined in global.css). (8) Responsive: projects-grid-new is 2-col at 1040px, 1-col at 768px. Timeline goes single-column at 768px. (9) .portfolio-app-root gets min-height: 100svh and flex-direction: column.
